div.p: Elizabeth Place was a central Melbourne laneway located between Elizabeth and Swanston streets. It extended north from Flinders Lane and connected with a perpendicular right-of-way providing access with Elizabeth Street. Whilst still in existence in 1915, it has since been discontinued.
